summary: Five supported EventService mutation paths (create_recurring, update_occurrence, delete_occurrence, update_all_day_occurrence, delete_all_day_occurrence) never call record_caldav_change, violating T12's 'No supported Happening mutation bypasses DAV sync' and 'every supported path has regression coverage'.
defects: backend/src/event.rs:382-445 — create_recurring commits without calling record_caldav_change; recurring event creation is invisible to DAV sync-collection, violating 'No supported Happening mutation bypasses DAV sync'
backend/src/event.rs:847-934 — update_occurrence commits without calling record_caldav_change; T12 scope explicitly includes 'occurrence changes'
backend/src/event.rs:936-998 — delete_occurrence commits without calling record_caldav_change; T12 scope explicitly includes 'occurrence changes'
backend/src/event.rs:685-776 — update_all_day_occurrence commits without calling record_caldav_change; T12 scope explicitly includes 'occurrence changes'
backend/src/event.rs:778-845 — delete_all_day_occurrence commits without calling record_caldav_change; T12 scope explicitly includes 'occurrence changes'
follow_up: MCP internal create_event (mcp_internal.rs:534) and update_event (mcp_internal.rs:575) reference non-existent columns start_utc/end_utc (schema has timed_start_utc/timed_end_utc) and bypass EventService entirely; they will fail at runtime and also bypass DAV sync
No regression tests exist for DAV change recording on any occurrence or create_recurring path
important_context: record_caldav_change is only called in create, update (move + non-move), and delete; all five occurrence/recurring-create paths are missing it
The move path (update with target_calendar_id != source_calendar_id) is correctly instrumented and tested
